title: Data Engineer (Apache NIFI) Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Senior profile (minimum 5 years of professional experience)
  • Very strong data transformation skills , with proven hands-on experience in complex transformation scenarios.
  • Solid knowledge of XML , including advanced usage of XPath for data extraction, manipulation, and validation.
  • At least 2 years of eperience with Apache NIFI.
  • Good understanding of data integration concepts and flow-based programming.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
  • Fluent English
  • Williness to move to Portugal



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Design visually engaging websites using UI/UX best practices, accessibility standards, and performance guidelines in Figma.
  • Develop approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Use AI tools (Gemini, Claude) for web design, development, and prototyping.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Figma/Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing using Figma AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds.
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you!


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Full Stack Sênior (React + Node.js)
description:
Quem somos:

Prezensa, uma empresa de tecnologia com foco em pessoas e compromisso real com resultados.

Nascemos da fusão de três consultorias com mais de 10 anos de trajetória (ESX, DevLand e Squad Premium) para criar um novo modelo no setor: mais humano, mais presente, mais estratégico.

Fomos pioneiros ao lançar a primeira PeopleTech do Brasil, unindo excelência técnica com acompanhamento próximo, de ponta a ponta.

Aqui, cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito.

Nossa cultura é baseada em transparência, colaboração e inovação. Valorizamos a autonomia e o desenvolvimento contínuo de nossos talentos.


Você se identifica com esse propósito? Então, o seu futuro é na Prezensa.


Atividades:

  • Criação de experiência de uso otimizada para usuário final
  • Colaboração com equipe multidisciplinar composta por desenvolvedores, designers e stakeholders
  • Resolução de problemas complexos com identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e proposição de soluções inovadoras
  • Produção de código limpo, testado, de fácil manutenção, alinhado às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software
  • Participação em processos de revisão de código como autor e revisor, assegurando qualidade e funcionalidade das features
  • Monitoramento de aplicações em produção por meio de métricas de saúde e performance


Hard Skills:

HTML e CSS avançados, design responsivo com media queries, propriedades relativas, flexbox e CSS grid, React com Redux para controle de estado, SPAs com Server Side Render. NodeJS e npm, design de APIs REST com Express, GraphQL com Apollo, modelo arquitetural de micro-serviços. JavaScript com domínio dos paradigmas orientado a objetos e funcional, testes unitários. Aplicação de princípios DRY, KISS, TDA, SoC e SOLID, utilização de design patterns criacionais, estruturais e comportamentais, entrega de software seguindo princípios PaaS 12factor. Git e versionamento de código, CI/CD com GitLab CI, ferramentas de lint/hint como ESLint, monitoramento de métricas de performance e erros.


Soft Skills:

Trabalho em equipe;

Proatividade;

Dinamismo;

Bom relacionamento interpessoal e com cliente;

Senso de urgência;

Objetividade e clareza na exposição de ideias para o time;

Boa comunicação oral e escrita.


O que nós oferecemos:

Descontos nas Universidades FIAP, FGV, EBAC, Impacta e Full Cycle

Parceria com a Open English e Cellep para aprimoramento do inglês

Oportunidade de realizar cursos e certificações

Apoio para participação em eventos de TI

Acesso a serviços de saúde e bem-estar através da nossa parceria com a Wellhub.

Acesso à Onhappy, plataforma exclusiva que oferece descontos em passagens aéreas e hospedagens.

description:
⚠️ Important Application Notice

Please select only the role that best aligns with your experience. We will only review your first application. If you apply to multiple positions on LinkedIn, additional submissions will not be processed and may cause your application to be overlooked.


Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic & Video Content Designer

We are building a fast-growing brand in the health and wellness industry and are seeking a strategic, creative, and performance-driven Graphic & Video Content Designer.

This is a key position within the company, with direct impact on sales performance, brand positioning, and overall growth. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, can manage a high volume of projects, and enjoy taking creative ownership, this opportunity is for you.

Responsibilities

• Create high-impact graphic and video content for paid ads, social media, email marketing, website, and online marketplaces

• Develop creative concepts aligned with marketing strategy and conversion objectives

• Produce short-form videos optimized for TikTok, Instagram, Meta Ads, and Amazon

• Prepare and finalize print-ready files for production, ensuring proper bleed, safety margins, color profiles, and print specifications

• Develop technical files for packaging, labels, and promotional materials

• Conduct quality control checks before production

• Maintain brand consistency across all platforms

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines with strong organization and attention to detail

Requirements

• Minimum of 3 years of proven experience in Graphic Design and/or Video Editing

• Hands-on experience preparing print-ready files and packaging materials

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite

• Proven experience with CorelDRAW

• Strong understanding of color profiles, CMYK, RGB, resolution, and print production standards

• Strong portfolio showcasing real projects, preferably performance-driven and e-commerce focused

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

• High level of organization and attention to detail

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred, but portfolio quality and proven experience carry greater weight.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to grow within a fast-expanding brand

• Dynamic and challenging work environment

• Strategic projects with direct business impact

• Competitive compensation based on experience

Application Requirements

Mandatory: Please include a portfolio link showcasing both graphic and video projects. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

In addition, please include your expected monthly compensation for the services to be provided.

title: AWS AI/ML Architect (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Projetar soluções utilizando serviços da AWS para IA generativa, como Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker.
  • Definir padrões de orquestração de agentes, integração com APIs e workflows corporativos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar AI Agents capazes de executar tarefas, consultas e automações complexas.
  • Construir pipelines de RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) para acesso a dados corporativos.
  • Integrar agentes com sistemas bancários, APIs internas e plataformas digitais.
  • Implementar memória de agentes, ferramentas (tools) e mecanismos de reasoning.
  • Aplicar AI Agents para acelerar desenvolvimento e modernização de aplicações.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Smart Engineering e AI-assisted development.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos de segurança, compliance e governança de dados do setor financeiro.
  • Definir modelos de observabilidade e métricas de performance para agentes de IA.
  • Monitorar qualidade de respostas, latência e custo de inferência.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência com Agents Builder / desenvolvimento de AI Agents
  • Experiência em Arquitetura Cloud (AWS)
  • Experiência com Amazon Bedrock e Amazon SageMaker
  • Domínio em RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • conhecimento em MLOps
  • conhecimento em Spring Boot / Java
  • Integração com APIs REST
  • Orquestração de agentes e workflows
  • Implementação de memória, tools e reasoning em agentes de IA
  • Integração com sistemas corporativos e plataformas digitais
  • Observabilidade e monitoramento de IA (qualidade de resposta, latência e custo de inferência)

title: Remote Government Sector Expert - 65106
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role overview:

We are looking for public sector domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in government, policy, and social service domains


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic, first-person prompts based on actual job workflows
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world public sector and policy scenarios
  • Select and use relevant public data/documents as input files
  • Ensure prompts are clear, specific, and aligned to the occupation
  • Review tasks for accuracy, completeness, and real-world relevance


Requirements:

  • Degree in Social Work, Public Administration, Management, or related field
  • Strong understanding of real-world workflows in your profession
  • Ability to convert work scenarios into structured, high-quality prompts


Who can Apply :

We are open to many experts within the public sector (including but not limited to): Child, Family, and School Social Workers, First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives, Recreation Workers, Compliance Officers, Administrative Services Managers.


Terms of Contract :

  • Opportunity is for a project that is ~2 week duration with potential extension


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour


We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.


We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.


About the Role


You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:


  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance


This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:


  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Ensino superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas


Sólida experiência comprovada em atividades de desenvolvimento de software (Frontend e Backend):


  • Backend
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java 17+ e Spring Boot 3.3.x.
  • Experiência com Spring WebFlux (Programação Reativa).
  • Implementação de Spring Security com OAuth2 Client (especialmente integrações SSO como Gov.br).
  • Conhecimento em Spring Cloud, OpenFeign, JPA/Hibernate e MapStruct.
  • Manipulação de banco de dados PostgreSQL e controle de versionamento de schemas com Flyway.

  • Qualidade e Infraestrutura
  • Testes: Escrita de testes unitários com JUnit 5, Mockito, Jasmine/Karma e uso de WireMock.
  • DevOps: Experiência com Docker, orquestração em Kubernetes (K8s) e pipelines GitLab CI/CD.
  • Ferramentas: Gestão de dependências com Maven, redução de boilerplate com Lombok e documentação com SpringDoc/Swagger.

  • Conhecimento em Kafka Connect ou Kafka Streams.
  • Experiência com o Design System do Governo Federal (GovBR DS).
  • Familiaridade com armazenamento em nuvem via AWS SDK S3.
  • Prática em Code Review técnico focado em manutenibilidade e segurança.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Company:

Our client is a leading provider of org chart automation and workforce planning software that empowers HR professionals and the people leaders they support. To support our fast-growing team, we are hiring a Software Support Specialist who enjoys solving problems, helping customers succeed, and working closely with a team that cares deeply about the product and the people who use it.

In this role, you will work directly with customers to help them get the most value out of our client’s SaaS platform. You will troubleshoot issues, guide users through configuration and best practices, and partner with internal teams to improve both the product and the customer experience.

This is a hands-on role in a collaborative team where curiosity, ownership, and a growth mindset are valued. If you enjoy technology, learning new systems, and turning complex problems into clear solutions for customers, you will thrive here.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support for web-based platform, helping customers resolve issues and use the product effectively
  • Work directly with customers to configure our product and guide them through best practices for importing and managing organizational data
  • Investigate and resolve support tickets with a focus on timely, thoughtful communication and a positive client experience
  • Collaborate with internal teams to escalate and resolve complex issues
  • Identify patterns in support requests and provide feedback that helps improve the product and documentation
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases and help refine support processes as the company grows


Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience supporting web-based applications or SaaS platforms
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose technical issues clearly and efficiently
  • Comfort working directly with customers and explaining technical concepts in a clear, approachable way
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and systems
  • Self-motivation and ownership in identifying problems and improving processes
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across teams to find solutions
  • Sound judgment and attention to detail

title: Software LLM Annotator
description:
Job Title: Software LLM Annotator

  • Location: Remote
  • Engagement Type: Contract
  • Duration: 5 Weeks
  • Open Positions: 50+
  • Work Hours: 8 hours/day (4 hours PST overlap mandatory)
  • Note: Candidates must have their own working machine (no system will be provided)

About the Role

  • Work on evaluating and improving outputs generated by Large Language Models (LLMs)
  • Involves a mix of technical understanding, analysis, and structured annotation
  • Requires ability to work with AI systems, workflows, and developer tools

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in software development, technical support, or similar technical roles
  • Strong familiarity with Linux environments and command-line operations
  • Proficiency in Python or Bash scripting
  • Ability to break down complex problems into structured, step-by-step workflows
  • Strong attention to detail in documenting technical processes
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows
  • Basic understanding of APIs, file systems, and developer tools
  • Familiarity with OpenClaw or similar tools

Nice to Have

  • Experience in data annotation, RLHF, or SFT workflows
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, REST APIs, and terminal-based automation
  • Experience with browser automation or developer productivity tools
  • Background in evaluating or improving AI-generated outputs

title: Lead Java Developer
description:
Job Title: Java Developer

Location: Brazil / Mexico / Costa Rica

Work Mode: Remote

Employment Type: Contract


Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Java Developer to join a dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Java 8+ , relevant frameworks (Spring, Hibernate ), relational databases, RESTful APIs, version control, and basic frontend knowledge. This role requires problem-solving, adaptability, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Responsibilities

  • Develop applications using Java 8+ and frameworks like Spring and Hibernate .
  • Apply strong object-oriented programming (OOP) principles.
  • Work with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL , and write optimized queries.
  • Build, maintain, and consume RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Use version control tools like Git for collaboration and code management.
  • Collaborate with frontend teams using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React .
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications.
  • Work with ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence for task and project tracking.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and a dynamic work environment.
  • Communicate effectively with teams and stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • Proficiency in Java 8+ and frameworks (Spring, Hibernate, etc. )
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles
  • Experience with relational databases (Oracle, MySQL, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with RESTful APIs and web services
  • Experience with version control tools (Git)
  • Familiarity with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React )
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow, Jira, and Confluence
  • Ability to adapt and learn quickly in a dynamic environment


Desirable Skills

  • Experience with microservices architecture
  • Familiarity with Agile / Scrum methodologies
  • Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Strong collaboration in cross-functional and remote teams


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in a relevant field
  • Technical certifications related to Java development are highly recommended

title: Preparador de Casos de Imigração Sênior
description:
Estamos contratando um Senior Immigration Document Preparer com experiência comprovada em casos humanitários como VISTO T, VISTO U, VAWA e processos em COURT AMERICANA .

Essa posição é para profissionais que já trabalham com imigração , entendem a estrutura dos casos e conseguem preparar processos com alto nível de organização, precisão e responsabilidade.

Se você ainda está aprendendo ou nunca trabalhou diretamente com esses tipos de caso, essa vaga não é para você.

Responsabilidades

• Preparação completa de casos de imigração

• Organização e revisão de documentos

• Montagem de pacotes de aplicação

• Suporte à equipe jurídica

• Controle de prazos e deadlines

• Garantir consistência e precisão nos processos


Casos com os quais você irá trabalhar

• T Visa

• U Visa

• VAWA

• Asylum

• Immigration Court cases


Requisitos obrigatórios

• Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência REAL com imigração americana

• Experiência direta com T Visa, U Visa, VAWA, Asylum ou Court (Sabe o que são?)

• Perfil extremamente organizado e atento a detalhes

• Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos e grande volume de documentos

• Profissional proativo e focado em solução de problemas


Diferenciais

• Experiência prévia em law firm de imigração

• Conhecimento de processos em Immigration Court

• Experiência preparando casos humanitários complexos


Formato

Remote (Home Office)


Remuneração

Entre R$2.000 a R$6.000

(de acordo com experiência e performance)


Importante

Para se candidatar, inclua na aplicação:

1️⃣ Quantos anos você trabalha com imigração

2️⃣ Quais desses casos você já preparou:

T Visa / U Visa / VAWA / Asylum / Court

3️⃣ Em qual escritório ou empresa você adquiriu essa experiência

Aplicações sem essas informações serão desconsideradas automaticamente.

title: Senior Media Buyer
description:
At Wisevu™ and our sister brands Homevu™ and CharityMarketing.com, we’ve been driving digital marketing success for over 17 years, specializing in SEO, digital PR, AI, content marketing, and web development for healthcare, home services, and charity clients in the United States and Canada.


What Will You Do?

  • This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Media Buyer.
  • Plan, launch, and manage high-ROAS paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant platforms.
  • Write compelling Ads sales copy that drives clicks and conversions.
  • Conduct A/B testing on ad creatives and landing pages to continuously improve performance.
  • Implement and test conversion tracking & analyze campaign performance using analytics tools.
  • Collaborate with the Paid Media Manager and cross-functional teams to create high-performing campaigns.


Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
  • Professional English fluency.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Work experience in a digital marketing (advertising) agency.
  • Strong marketing knowledge and ability to write persuasive sales copy.


Benefits:

  • Fully remote work.
  • Competitive salary, which will be negotiated during the interview based on competencies, skills, and experience.
  • Annual salary review.
  • Premium training programs and access to an internal mentorship team with vast experience in digital marketing.
  • Professional equipment budget.
  • Access to cutting-edge tools.
  • Long-term and stable working relationship in a company thats been growing since 2008.


We’re excited to see your work and hear your ideas, and work on exciting projects together. 


We kindly ask that you provide us with your resume in English.

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software Pleno - ADVPL | TI
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Desenvolver e sustentar funcionalidades de software, que agreguem valor ao produto, garantindo a satisfação do cliente dentro da área de atuação


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de média complexidade, com nível de supervisão moderado e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias envolvidas no projeto;
  • Compreender a arquitetura do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de média complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de baixa e média complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento;
  • Utiliza frameworks já definidos para o desenvolvimento de soluções


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação: : Superior completo em tecnologia e afins.
  • Lógica de Programação;
  • Banco de Dados – nível intermediário;
  • Linguagem de programação utilizada pelo time (exemplo: ADVLP, PO.UI, Angular);
  • Fundamento em testes unitários;
  • Arquitetura web – nível básico;
  • Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software – desejável nível Intermediário;
  • Regras de negócio do Protheus e seus módulos.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: CUA Trajectory Specialist - 65129
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical business problems.


Role Overview:

We are looking for skilled professionals to contribute as S2 Annotators , responsible for producing and validating high-quality Computer-Use Agent (CUA) trajectories for developer-adjacent workflows. This includes tasks such as file operations, light scripting, API interactions, and browser automation.

This role requires a strong understanding of technical workflows, attention to detail, and the ability to translate natural language instructions into precise, step-by-step executable actions that can be used to train advanced AI systems.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create detailed, step-by-step positive CUA trajectories for technical tasks (e.g., file manipulation, scripting, API calls, browser-based workflows)
  • Break down natural language instructions into clear, verifiable actions
  • Validate and review trajectories for correctness, completeness, and reproducibility
  • Work within Linux desktop environments to execute and document workflows
  • Use scripting (Python/Bash) to simulate or validate task execution where required
  • Interact with tools and environments involving APIs, terminals, and browser automation
  • Collaborate with internal teams to refine task quality and annotation guidelines
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and high-quality standards across all annotations


Requirements:

  • 2–5 years of experience in software development, technical support, or similar technical roles
  • Strong familiarity with Linux environments and command-line operations
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python or Bash
  • Ability to decompose complex instructions into structured, step-by-step workflows
  • Strong attention to detail in documenting technical processes
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows
  • Basic understanding of APIs, file systems, and developer tooling
  • Familiarity with OpenClaw or similar environments/tools


Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience in data annotation, RLHF, or SFT labeling workflows
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, REST APIs, or terminal-based automation
  • Experience working with browser automation tools or developer productivity tools
  • Background in evaluating or improving AI-generated outputs


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work with cutting-edge AI technology and contribute to next-generation systems
  • Flexible, remote work environment
  • Opportunity to collaborate with leading AI researchers and engineers
  • Competitive compensation based on your expertise
  • Long-term engagement opportunities


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 20 hours per week, with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 5 weeks; (expected start date is next week).
  • Location: Remote (India, Brazil, Mexico, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, Ghana, Turkey)


Evaluation Process:

  • Resume screening
  • Take home assessment (60 mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: GESTOR DE FUNIL
description:
LINK DO FORMULÁRIO PARA CADASTRAR-SE PARA VAGA:

Clique aqui > TypeformFaça parte do nosso time!

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Estruturar, organizar e otimizar funis de vendas de Direct Response (Front-end, Upsell, Downsell, Cross-sell e Order Bump);
  • Analisar métricas de conversão (CVR, AOV, CPA, LTV, lucro por lead);
  • Atualizar e consolidar indicadores de performance financeira dos funis (DRE por produto, margem, CMV, comissões e reembolsos);
  • Apoiar na montagem de projeções de fluxo de caixa por oferta;
  • Cruzar dados de diferentes plataformas (checkout, CRM, gateways de pagamento, afiliados);
  • Analisar cenários de preço (A/B), impacto em AOV, lucro por lead e taxas de reembolso;
  • Identificar gargalos de conversão e propor testes estruturados;
  • Coordenar melhorias de funil junto às áreas de Copy, Video, Tech, Produto e Backend;
  • Organizar roadmap de projetos de funil e garantir entregas dentro do prazo;
  • Validar integrações entre checkout, CRM, e-mail, SMS e webhooks;
  • Apoiar na preparação de relatórios operacionais para diretoria (margem por produto, lucro por lead, eficiência de funil, performance de ofertas);
  • Participar ativamente da definição de prioridades estratégicas com base em dados.

QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Experiência sólida com funis de vendas
  • Excel / Google Sheets avançado – uso de fórmulas complexas para manipulação de grandes bases de dados;
  • Experiência com métricas de performance digital (AOV, CPA, CVR, LTV);
  • Experiência com demonstrativos financeiros aplicados a marketing (DRE por produto, margem de contribuição);
  • Experiência com modelagem de cenários para tomada de decisão;
  • Conhecimento de integrações entre plataformas (checkout, CRM, gateways);
  • Elevado grau de responsabilidade com dados, indicadores e impacto financeiro;
  • Perfil analítico ativo: capacidade de interpretar resultados e propor soluções estratégicas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de HTML e lógica básica de JavaScript (edição de scripts, botões e redirecionamentos), configuração de webhooks e familiaridade com pixels, UTMs e validação de eventos.
  • Capacidade de debugar problemas de funil em produção (redirecionamentos, integrações e tracking), com autonomia para resolver falhas técnicas sem depender constantemente do time de TI.
  • Diferencial :
  • Experiência com mercado internacional e afiliados.
  • Se fluente em inglês.

COMPETÊNCIAS:

  • PROATIVIDADE
  • ANALÍTICO
  • FOCO EM RESULTADO
  • ORGANIZAÇÃO
  • CAPACIDADE DE PRIORIZAÇÃO
  • RESOLUTIVO
  • COMUNICAÇÃO CLARA

SALÁRIO:

  • A combinar
  • Bônus trimestral - Vale a partir do segundo Trimestre dentro da empresa.

TIPO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:

  • A prestação de serviço será feita no Regime PJ.
  • 100% Home Office

COMO FUNCIONA O TRABALHO:

  • Nossa comunicação é feita pelo discord, o candidato aprovado tem que estar disponível na plataforma para responder e se comunicar. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • Usamos o ClickUp para gerenciar as atividades da equipe. (Você receberá treinamento para isso)
  • O candidato selecionado terá um período de três meses para ganhar experiência na empresa antes de ser efetivado na vaga

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Salesforce Configuration Specialist
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Salesforce Configuration Specialist to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only) , offering the chance to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


We are seeking a Salesforce Configuration Specialist with strong hands-on experience in complex configurations and data management. This role is focused on delivering scalable, high-quality solutions using declarative tools , with a strong emphasis on Flows, security, and data integrity .


Key Responsibilities

  • Execute advanced Salesforce configurations (Flows, Experience Cloud, automation, custom fields, permissions)
  • Manage data migration and ensure data quality and consistency
  • Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions
  • Troubleshoot configuration and data reconciliation issues
  • Provide training and create user/technical documentation

title: Analista de qualidade sênior
description:
Analista de Qualidade Sênior


Sobre a Empresa: A Syonet é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais voltadas para o setor automotivo, com foco em concessionárias. Através de sistemas de CRM, ferramentas de gestão e inteligência artificial, a Syonet promove a transformação digital, otimizando processos, melhorando a experiência do cliente e

proporcionando insights estratégicos baseados em dados para aumentar a eficiência e os resultados das empresas do setor.


Sobre o cargo: Como QA Sênior você será referência estratégica e técnica dentro da Squad, além da confiabilidade de nossos produtos. Liderando a estratégia de qualidade, definindo processos que antecipam riscos e garantem entregas de alto impacto. Será responsável por colaborar com

Tech Leads e Arquitetos para integrar a qualidade em todo o ciclo de vida do software (SDLC). Além de dominar testes manuais e automatizados, atuará como mentor do time, disseminando boas práticas, otimizando a base de conhecimento e elevando o padrão técnico da organização.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar scripts e frameworks de testes automatizados para aumentar a eficiência do ciclo de entrega;
  • Atuar como referência técnica (mentor) para desenvolvedores e QAs menos experientes, apoiando decisões junto a Tech Leads e Arquitetos;
  • Planejar e executar testes funcionais, integrados, regressão e performance, garantindo que os requisitos do projeto sejam atendidos integralmente;
  • Estruturar a documentação de módulos e funcionalidades na Base de Conhecimento, assegurando a rastreabilidade e a confiabilidade dos testes;
  • Identificar gargalos nos processos de desenvolvimento e implementar métricas de qualidade para monitorar a saúde do produto.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Proficiência na área da Qualidade de Software. (experiência mínima de 5 anos);
  • Graduação concluída na área de TI;
  • Domínio em ferramentas de automação (Playwright, Cypress ou equivalentes);
  • Conhecimento em Postgres e linguagem SQL para a realização de consultas e validação de dados;
  • Experiência prática em testes de APIs (REST/SOAP) com Postman, SoapUI, Insomnia ou ferramentas similares;
  • Experiência com testes Mobile;
  • Experiência em linguagem de Programação (JavaScript, Typescript);
  • Conhecimento em padrões de projetos;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Observabilidade (Grafana, DataDog ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD como Gitlab.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Vivência na integração de testes automatizados em pipelines de deploy contínuo;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de testes de desempenho como JMeter, Gatling ou k6;
  • Noções de testes de vulnerabilidades e segurança da informação;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e uso de IA generativa;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria;
  • Possuir certificações como CTFL (ISTQB), CTAL ou especializações em Automação de Testes.



Por que #VemParaSyonet? Temos um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e focado na qualidade e cheio de oportunidades para crescer com a gente.

title: Especialista SRE

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional experiente e proativo(a) para atuar como Especialista SRE em uma empresa de tecnologia líder no setor. Nesta função, você contribuirá com a evolução e padronização da ferramenta Azure DevOps, a sustentação e automação de ambientes baseados em Kubernetes, e a gestão de infraestrutura cloud e on-premises.

  • Criar e customizar Work Item Types, Process Templates, Workflows e Rules no Azure DevOps.

  • Experiência sólida em Azure DevOps e customização de Work Items e Workflows.
  • 3 anos de experiência com Kubernetes e Terraform.
  • Experiência com AWS e Azure.
  • Conhecimento em APIs e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Espanhol avançado

title: Especialista SRE
description:

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional experiente e proativo(a) para atuar como Especialista SRE em uma empresa de tecnologia líder no setor. title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Account Manager
description:
THIS ROLE REQUIRES RELOCATING TO TAIWAN FOR 6 MONTHS FOR MANDATORY TRAINING


Main Responsibilities:


  • Develop long-term relationships with key customers, ensuring consistent engagement and satisfaction
  • Oversee and expand revenue streams within an assigned portfolio by identifying growth opportunities
  • Collaborate with clients to improve game visibility and performance through targeted marketing and promotional activities
  • Contribute to securing and maintaining favorable commercial terms in partnerships
  • Coordinate closely with internal marketing teams to deliver high-quality and effective promotional campaigns
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by sharing insights, best practices, and industry knowledge
  • Provide prompt and efficient support to operators, ensuring all requests are handled in a timely manner


Desired experience:


  • Previous experience in account management, business development, or similar client-facing roles, ideally within iGaming, gaming, or digital entertainment (preferred but not strictly mandatory)
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build lasting relationships
  • Familiarity with marketing strategies and promotional planning is advantageous
  • Good organizational skills and ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Brazilian nationality or eligibility to work in Brazil is required
  • Willingness to undergo an initial training period in Taiwan before transitioning to a role based in Brazil (mandatory)

title: Profissional Cientista de Dados
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Estamos buscando um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Inteligência Artificial, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos baseados em LLMs .

Buscamos profissional com:

✔️ +5 anos em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning

✔️ Experiência prática com IA Generativa e LLMs

✔️ Arquitetura RAG (embeddings, bancos vetoriais, retrieval)

✔️ Construção de agentes (ReAct / tool calling)

✔️ Prompt engineering e mitigação de hallucinations

✔️ Python, NLP, APIs REST, SQL

✔️ Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Estamos buscando um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Inteligência Artificial, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos baseados em LLMs .

Buscamos profissional com:

✔️ +5 anos em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning

✔️ Experiência prática com IA Generativa e LLMs

✔️ Arquitetura RAG (embeddings, bancos vetoriais, retrieval)

✔️ Construção de agentes (ReAct / tool calling)

✔️ Prompt engineering e mitigação de hallucinations

✔️ Python, NLP, APIs REST, SQL

✔️ Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Descrição da Empresa A De.Col Odontologia é uma clínica comprometida em oferecer atendimento humanizado e de alta qualidade aos seus pacientes. Valorizamos a excelência nos serviços prestados e mantemos um ambiente acolhedor e profissional. Nosso objetivo é atender às necessidades individuais de cada paciente, promovendo saúde e bem-estar. Localizada em Telêmaco Borba, PR, buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer e contribuir com a excelência de nossa equipe.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um profissional para o cargo de atendimento ao cliente/auxiliar administrativo. As principais responsabilidades incluem realizar o atendimento presencial e telefônico, agendar consultas, organizar documentos e auxiliar nas rotinas administrativas da clínica. O profissional será responsável por garantir uma comunicação eficiente e um ambiente de acolhimento para os pacientes. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e necessita de presença no local em Telêmaco Borba, PR.

Qualificações

  • Atendimento e Comunicação: Necessário ter habilidades em etiqueta telefônica e comunicação clara para lidar com os pacientes e equipe de forma profissional e empática.
  • Assistência Administrativa: Experiência em assistência administrativa e executiva, incluindo organização de agendas e suporte administrativo geral.
  • Habilidades Clericais: Conhecimento em funções como organização de documentos, controle de arquivos e gerenciamento de informações administrativas.
  • Qualificações adicionais como experiência em atendimento ao cliente, habilidades em ferramentas de software de gestão e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe serão diferenciais.

HORÁRIO DE TRABALHO :12 ATE 19 HRS DE SEGUNDA A SEXTA

title: Consultor Funcional SAP, Testes, Negócios
description:
CHAMADA ÚNICA – BOOTCAMP SAP CCS|PROGRAMA DE CAPACITAÇÃO


Não perca a oportunidade de fazer parte de um Programa de Capacitação exclusivo para um processo de seleção do BOOTCAMP SAP CCS - Customer Care & Service.

Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:


O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.


O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.


Vantagens de participar:

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento


Informações importantes:


Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.


Idioma: não é requerido, mas se tiver aumentam suas chances de participação


Etapas do processo: Triagem|Teste de Raciocínio Lógico|Entrevistas RH e Técnicas


Localização: residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil, preferencialmente para a região de SP, RJ e BH.


Participação: Formação Custeada Integralmente


Se você atende aos requisitos mínimos, envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail:(Bootcamp SAP CCS)


Vagas limitadas! Não perca essa oportunidade única de transformar sua carreira!

Ative para ver a imagem maior.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Backend - Especialista
description:
O seu papel como Especialista em Engenharia de Software Backend será:

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;
  • Liderança no desenvolvimento de projetos com arquitetura de microserviços, consumo e geração de eventos em Streaming, API's;
  • Garantir a funcionalidade, manutenibilidade e velocidade, além de práticas de teste e qualidade;
  • Atuar como referência técnica dentro do time, atuando como mentor de pares de menor senioridade;
  • Garantir que todas as soluções técnicas estejam alinhadas a estratégia do negócio e entender iniciativas relacionadas ao produto;
  • Ajudar o time no desenho de soluções com arquitetura evolutiva, além de investigar constantemente novas tecnologias e formas de trabalho;
  • Colaborar com a evolução das habilidades técnicas do time e esforços de melhoria contínua que impactam vários times;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, em que práticas de pareamento, feedbacks e motivação para se desenvolver são comuns a todos os squads.


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Conhecimento avançado em desenvolvimento em Golang ou Typescript ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes ;
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade ;
  • Conhecimento sobre testes unitários e de integração;
  • Preocupação com a qualidade e desempenho das soluções propostas;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento e implementação de APIs ;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos ;
  • Embasamento teórico, habilidade e preocupação com a excelência técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (DDD, Arquitetura, Design de Código, Paradigmas, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.


Seria legal se você conhecesse:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento em C# ;
  • Google Cloud Continuous Integration;
  • Continuous Delivery.
