title: Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our team. You will primarily be utilizing .NET Core, C#, SQL. We hire innovative software development professionals who can work well within a highly collaborative, agile team to develop high quality, testable software. Ideally, you will have a wide breadth of experience performing development in a .NET environment and developing integrations to third-party systems.


Responsibilities:

  • Developing SaaS applications, including .NET APIs, and React applications
  • Working with our product organization to understand business requirements and objectives
  • Contributing to overall system architecture strategy and design
  • Leading by example and setting a high standard for code quality
  • Performing code and design reviews
  • Motivating an agile team and fostering collaboration and innovation across our development organization


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years full-stack experience working through design, implementation, testing, and delivering high availability enterprise applications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or 4-6 years of related experience
  • Should have a record of successful delivery of software applications as an individual and with a team
  • Strong understanding of the Agile software development methodologies and principles
  • Experience with CI/CD
  • Must have strong experience and exhibit in-depth knowledge of .NET Core, C#, SQL, MVC, SOA, Web API, Microservices, JavaScript, Typescript, HTML
  • Frontend experience is a plus (Angular, React)
  • Understanding of cloud native applications (Azure, AWS)

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Gerente de negócios
description:
Descrição da vaga


Evoluir as práticas, ferramentas e habilidades de administração de vendas e gestão de contas para aprimorar o atendimento das expectativas dos nossos clientes e expandir em novos negócios


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar as áreas de negócios na prospecção, qualificação e fechamento de oportunidades de vendas, identificando necessidades, prazos e orçamento para a venda de produtos e/ou serviços oferecidos pela empresa, e utilizando o CRM na gestão das contas nomeadas e oportunidades em cada fase do processo de venda, visando atingir as metas estabelecidas;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais para venda de produtos e serviços em soluções departamentais e/ou corporativas, negociando as condições das propostas para a efetivação da venda e analisando condições técnicas e comerciais de contratos de prestação de serviços com base na orientação da área de Contratos;
  • Estruturar proposta técnica com apoio do arquiteto, entendendo os requisitos do cliente, identificando e estruturando soluções de negócios que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e compondo preços de vendas de produtos/soluções e serviços;
  • Formular termos de referências e propostas comerciais, utilizando como referência modelos existentes e contando com apoio (Gestão, Executivo, Arquiteto, Gerente de Negócios ou Analista de Negócios);
  • Realizar apresentações executivas de produtos/soluções e serviços para clientes.
  • Criar estratégias de posicionamento dos produtos/soluções da Imagem nos clientes, mapeando perfis de cliente e identificando influenciadores, decisores, agentes externos e concorrentes;
  • Interagir com as todas as áreas promovendo o alinhamento de ideias e práticas em relação aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa;
  • Desenvolver e manter uma rede comercial consistente, contemplando carteira de clientes e rede de contatos que contribua para a geração de negócios da empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Graduação completa;
  • Conhecimento em processo de venda de produto e serviços;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Técnicas e habilidades para o desenvolvimento de vendas; Conhecimento dos principais concorrentes no mercado.


Habilidades Desejáveis:


  • Microsoft Office;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimentos de Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem;
  • Experiência em vendas de soluções para Governo;

title: Data Architect  - Analista Pleno
description:
Descrição do perfil

Responsável por construir, otimizar e manter modelos conceituais e lógicos de banco de dados.


Principais atividades

  • Apoiar em desenhos de soluções em escalas e plataformas capazes de gerenciar grandes quantidades de dados, estruturados e não estruturados, mesmo em modo de real time, através da escolha correta de arquiteturas de referência.
  • Colaborar com uma arquitetura de dados horizontal que fomente o reuso de soluções por diversas áreas da companhia otimizando os custos de implantação e de operação;
  • Desenhar soluções que garantam toda a governança, privacidade e qualidade dos dados;
  • Apoiar nas aplicações de políticas da empresa em termos de privacidade e segurança no acesso aos dados;
  • Descrever as tecnologias específicas em termos de integração entre componentes e fluxos lógicos de interação;
  • Observar as tendências tecnológicas emergentes e dar indicações sobre as melhores práticas;
  • Colaborar na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria por meio de integrações e substituições de sistemas legados;
  • Desenvolver protótipos e proof of concept em projetos de inovação;
  • Contribuir com a disseminação de uma cultura de Data-Driven Decision na companhia, fazendo interface entre áreas técnicas e as diversas áreas de negócio.


Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Conhecimento sobre pipeline de dados e todas as suas fases, desde a ingestão até tomada de decisão;
  • Conhecimento técnico de estruturas de dados (Bancos Relacionais, Não Relacionais e Big Data);
  • Conhecimento de soluções de nuvem, especialmente em Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Experiência na arquitetura de dados, especialmente em ambientes GCP e Azure;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação (SQL, Shell Script, Python, Java, etc.);
  • Ferramentas de visualização e exploração de dados (Power BI, Tableau, SAS, Data Studio etc);
  • Metodologias desenvolvimento lean/agile;
  • Experiência na coleta e análise de requisitos do sistema;
  • Cursando ensino superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Product Owner Especialista em ERP Linx Microvix
description:
Vaga: Product Owner Especialista em ERP Linx Microvix

Local: Brasil (remoto)

Área: Produto / Tecnologia / Varejo

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um Product Owner especialista em ERP Linx Microvix para liderar a evolução de soluções voltadas ao varejo. Este profissional será responsável por traduzir necessidades de negócio em funcionalidades de produto, garantindo que o ERP atenda às demandas operacionais, fiscais e estratégicas de redes varejistas.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Definir e gerenciar o roadmap do produto relacionado ao ERP Linx Microvix.
  • Priorizar e organizar o backlog de produto , criando e refinando user stories.
  • Traduzir necessidades do negócio em requisitos funcionais claros para o time de desenvolvimento .
  • Atuar como ponto de conexão entre stakeholders e equipes técnicas .
  • Conduzir sessões de refinamento de backlog, planejamento de sprints e reviews .
  • Definir critérios de aceite e validar entregas do time de desenvolvimento.
  • Mapear processos de varejo e propor melhorias operacionais dentro do sistema.
  • Participar da definição e acompanhamento de releases e versões do produto .


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada com ERP Linx Microvix .
  • Experiência como Product Owner, Product Manager ou Analista de Produto .
  • Conhecimento profundo de operações de varejo .
  • Experiência com metodologias Agile / Scrum .
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação funcional e regras de negócio .
  • Conhecimento em integrações de sistemas e APIs.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com POS de varejo ou soluções omnichannel .
  • Conhecimento em meios de pagamento e carteiras digitais
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia voltadas para varejo.

Competências comportamentais

  • Pensamento analítico
  • Comunicação clara entre áreas técnicas e de negócio
  • Organização e gestão de prioridades
  • Visão estratégica de produto

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.

  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

title: PI Analyst (Inglês Avançado)
description:
Experienced Analyst(s)


a) Responsibilities:

i. Manage PI historians (access, new tags, security, interfaces).

ii. Manage AF SQL servers (access, security, create/edit new databases).

iii. Work with PI analysts to get workflow tags created on in-country PI historians for workflow output.

b) Required Skills:

Soft Skills needed:

Able to work in an Agile environment.

Demonstrate critical thinking, analytical skills, and employ judgment to offer thoughtful, concise input toward resolution of problems.

Able to translate data requirements into business processes and reverse engineer business processes into data requirements.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills with strong English proficiency.

Leadership skills needed to successfully promote ideas, coordinate work activities, and plan deliverables within a project team.

This is a hands-on technical role; the analyst should be able to work independently with the business and also in a team environment.

Technical Skills:

2+ years of demonstrated work experience supporting PI and/or PI AF.

Basic understanding of sensor data.

Knowledge and experience of working with the PI AF client.

Adding new databases, elements, creating/editing templates and analyses.

Add additional attributes, calculations, analyses as required from workflow groups and update global templates and existing AF databases (these are requested as the workflow is developed for the site).

SME for AF Builder tool – understand how it works, what is required and be able to teach PI analysts supporting in-country PI historians.

Understanding how PI tags are created and what info is required.

Understanding how PI databases work with each other.

Extensive interface skills especially using OPC UA/OPC DA/PItoPI/PI System Connector.

Properly designing and implementing interfaces that start up quickly and bring in high resolution data (sub-second data).

Interfaces are designed in such a way that troubleshooting can be quick and possibly automated.

Data Archive System skills.

Configuring systems with high tag count and high data resolution.

Expert in data manipulation tools such as: TOAD, Access, Excel.

Applications experience (e.g., VB Programming).

Intermediate to advanced SQL querying (SQL Server/Oracle etc.).

Comprehension of DevOps and Agile development and application to data centric architecture and solutions.

Practical skill sets in Data visualization tools.

Knowledge of other programming languages (as specified in an Order or communicated verbally by Buyer, as needed) and ability to write code.

title: Agente de viagens
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Agente de Viagens para integrar nossa equipe na 4WAY Travel.


  • Operadora & Agência de Viagem com mais de 20 anos de mercado nos mesmos locais


  • Localizada nos melhores shoppings de São Paulo.


  • Atividades diárias incluirão: Elaboração de pacotes turísticos, atendimento a clientes buscando entender suas necessidades, reservas de passagens e hospedagens, além de acompanhamento de cotações e negociações com fornecedores.


  • Este é um cargo de tempo integral, presencial e com escalas 6X1 que inclui os finais de semana.


Qualificações


  • Serviços de Viagem: Experiência em montagem de roteiros, reservas de voos, hotéis e transporte, e atendimento ao cliente no setor de turismo.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Capacidade de se comunicar claramente, negociar com clientes e prestar um atendimento personalizado presencialmente e de forma remoto.
  • Organização e Planejamento: Proatividade, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades organizacionais para gerenciar múltiplas solicitações simultaneamente.
  • Necessario experiência prévia em agências de viagem ou operadoras turísticas e conhecimento em ferramentas de reservas e emissão de passagens e pacotes.

Realizar gestão de pessoas com foco em maximizar faturamento, qualidade, produtividade, segurança e meio ambiente, conservação de equipamentos, disciplina e motivação dos colaboradores, coordenar e desenvolver trabalhos de melhoria continua, otimizando processos e recursos, com objetivo de realizar a produção com qualidade total e atender as necessidades dos clientes internos e externos.

description:

Se você tem uma rede de contatos com empresários, médicos, agropecuaristas ou investidores com capital para alocar — quero conversar com você.

Não precisa de experiência em finanças. Precisa ter relacionamento com pessoas investidoras.

Se você é corretor de alto padrão, assessor, empresário com rede sólida ou simplesmente conhece as pessoas certas — me chama no privado.

Envie mensagem com \"CAMBORIÚ\" para eu te passar os detalhes.

Vagas limitadas — trabalho com poucos parceiros, mas os certos.

title: Profissional Técnico de Estrutura PL | PL Structure Technician Professional
description: *Job Description:** (Versão em Português)* Responsabilidades:* Realizar serviços de montagem de partes estruturais, ajustar carenagens de componentes aeronáuticos e montar opcionais diversos, de acordo com as instruções contidas nos dados técnicos aceitos e aprovados para a execução desses serviços. Cumprir os requisitos previstos no Manual da Organização de Manutenção (MOM) e no Manual do Controle da Qualidade (MCQ), para serviços executados nas oficinas de manutenção, em adição ao acima disposto Utilizar ferramentas e equipamentos necessários às atividades designadas, de forma a assegurar a execução do trabalho de acordo com práticas industriais de aceitação geral. Executar os serviços de reparo estrutural, observando criteriosamente o previsto nos projetos dos reparos, interpretando os desenhos técnicos apresentados. Regular, ajustar e montar as partes da estrutura de acordo com as instruções técnicas. Executar, caso não habilitado como mecânico de manutenção aeronáutica conforme RBAC 65, os serviços sob supervisão de um mecânico de manutenção aeronáutica habilitado pela ANAC. Submeter os trabalhos executados à apreciação e conferência do Supervisor e Aprovação para retorno ao serviço (APRS). Registrar os serviços executados e/ou supervisionados em conformidades com a legislação vigente, utilizando os formulários definidos pela empresa através do MOM/MCQ. Realizar os registros imediatamente após a finalização de cada atividade e garantir que todos os registros pertinentes ao serviço tenham sido realizados antes de considerar o serviço concluído. Manter limpo e organizado o seu posto de trabalho, recolhendo ao final da jornada todos os detritos produzidos na execução de suas atividades, depositando-os em local adequado e limpar, organizar e guardar todo o ferramental utilizado na execução de suas atividades, a fim de manter a organização da área de trabalho e garantir que nenhuma ferramenta ficou esquecida na aeronave. Atuar em serviços de apoio técnico à atividade de inovação, através da implantação e da manutenção de instalações ou equipamentos destinados à execução de projeto de pesquisa, desenvolvimento ou inovação tecnológica. Requisitos:* *Candidatos internos, realizar o "Aviso de Candidatura" conforme "Regra de Ouro".* Curso técnico completo (desejável em MMA). CHT em CEL válida. Prévia experiência em atividades de estruturas em materiais metálicos ou em atividades de estruturas em materiais compostos. Fluência em Português (verbal, escrita e leitura). Inglês intermediário. Benefícios:* Assistência médica e odontológica Vale alimentação Almoço no restaurante interno Transporte fretado Wellhub Seguro de vida diferenciado* PPRPrograma de compra de ações da Airbus Parcerias com farmácias, escolas, universidades, academia, entre outros Local de trabalho:* Itajubá / MG Horário: *Segunda a sexta das 7hr às 17h07 O que você encontrará por aqui:* Empresa com selo Top Employers (reconhecimento da excelência de políticas e práticas em gestão de pessoas). Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador. Projetos desafiadores que ampliam seus horizontes e conhecimentos. Oportunidade de crescimento e desenvolvimento, sendo o protagonista da sua carreira. Possibilidade de mobilidade dentro do Grupo Airbus.----------(English Version)* Responsabilities:* Carry out structural parts assembly services, adjust aircraft component fairings and assemble various options, in accordance with the instructions contained in the technical data accepted and approved for carrying out these services. Comply with the requirements set out in the Maintenance Organization Manual (MOM) and the Quality Control Manual (MCQ) for services carried out in the maintenance workshops, in addition to the above Use tools and equipment necessary for the assigned activities to ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with generally accepted industrial practices. Carry out structural repair services, carefully observing the provisions of the repair projects and interpreting the technical drawings submitted. Adjusting, fitting and assembling structural parts in accordance with technical instructions. If not qualified as an aircraft maintenance mechanic in accordance with RBAC 65, perform the services under the supervision of an aircraft maintenance mechanic qualified by ANAC. Submit the work carried out to the Supervisor for examination and approval for return to service (APRS). Record the services performed and/or supervised in accordance with current legislation, using the forms defined by the company through the MOM/MCQ. Make the records immediately after completing each activity and ensure that all records relevant to the service have been made before considering the service completed. Keeping their workstation clean and tidy, collecting all debris produced in the course of their activities at the end of the day and depositing it in an appropriate place, and cleaning, organizing and storing all tools used in the course of their activities, in order to maintain the organization of the work area and ensure that no tools are forgotten on the aircraft. Work in technical support services for innovation activities, through the implementation and maintenance of facilities or equipment intended for the execution of research, development or technological innovation projects. Requirements:* *Internal candidates, carry out the "Notice of Application" according to the "Golden Rule".* Completed technical course (MMA desirable). Valid CHT in CEL. Previous experience in structural work in metallic materials or structural work in composite materials. Fluency in Portuguese (verbal, writing and reading). Intermediate English. Benefits:* Medical and dental assistance Food vouchers Lunch in the in-house restaurant Chartered transportation Differentiated life insurance Wellhub* PPRAirbus share purchase program Partnerships with pharmacies, schools, universities, gyms, among others Place of work: *Itajubá / MG Hours: *Monday to Friday from 7 a.m. to 5:07 p.m. What you'll find here:* A company with the Top Employers seal (recognizing excellence in people management policies and practices). Dynamic, collaborative and innovative work environment. Challenging projects that broaden your horizons and knowledge. Opportunity for growth and development, being the protagonist of your career. Possibility of mobility within the Airbus Group.This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company's success, reputation and sustainable growth.****Company:**** Helicopteros do Brasil S/A - Helibras*Contract Type:* Permanent*Experience Level:* Professional*Job Family:* Material Support & servicesBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus. Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to .At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

description:
Como trabalhar na Grant Thornton?

Aqui o aprendizado e o desenvolvimento são constantes. E o nosso espírito colaborativo faz toda a diferença para o seu crescimento individual e conquistas em equipe.

Nossos tempos são formados por pessoas e talentos, com trajetórias, habilidades únicas. Inovação que diversidade é essencial para o fortalecimento da nossa organização e dos nossos colaboradores, refletindo em melhores, promovendo e continuados para nossos clientes.

title: Camunda 8 Developer
description:
Corus Consulting is a consulting firm with more than 15 years of experience with different clients worldwide; we have presence in Europe, United States, Asia and Mexico.

We are looking for your talent to work as:


Camunda 8 Developer


About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Camunda Developer with knowledge in the 8th version, to join our team supporting a customer in the banking sector.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop new components, maintain and evolve existent ones according to the team priorities and product roadmap.
  • Active role on team software quality assurance, best practices and agile methodology.
  • Take responsibility of the software delivery by ensuring quality and scope expectations are met.
  • Work closely with partner technology teams and collaborate effectively.


Requirements:

  • Hand-on experience designing and implementing Camunda 8 BPMN processes.
  • Deep understanding of Java (11 or above) and Java Spring (4 or superior) and solid understanding of OO principles.
  • Solid experience Spring Boot.
  • Diligent with automated testing i.e. JUnit/Mockito/Cucumber, etc.
  • Understanding of RESTful API principles.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B2).


Location:

  • Remote from Brazil.


Ready to bring your expertise to the next level? Apply now and join a team that's shaping the future of financial services.


Support the team and the Camunda Chapter!

description:

With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.

Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿ This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Please Read*

Duration: This is expected to be a 12 month engagement, potential for extensions

Location : Remote in Brazil

Notice Period: 3 weeks

Structure: CLT - this CANNOT be adjusted.

Pay: R$15,268 to R$20,000 monthly

Senior AI Back-End Engineer

Must Haves:

  • 1+ years of experience as an AI/ML Engineer
  • 2+ years of Python development experience, including API creation, model training, testing, and general backend programming
  • Familiarity with LangChain for building LLM workflows using tools, memory, and retrieval.
  • Strong communication skills – able to work independently while providing clear updates to the team

Plusses:

  • Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.)
  • Experience with OpenSearch
  • Experience with Airflow and understanding of data orchestration
  • Exposure to RAG architectures, especially visual RAG use cases

Day-to-Day:

We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (1 Mid-Level, 1 Senior) to join a small, focused team building backend features for an existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) service. You'll work on extracting structured data from diverse content types—images, graphs, eBooks, journals, and more—using visual-based models. This role involves experimentation, model development, and comparing LLMs for visual RAG use cases. You’ll deploy code to non-prod environments and support production rollout in collaboration with the DevOps team. While primarily a heads-down, individual contributor role, clear communication and collaboration with the team is expected.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack - React com Next.js


Localização: remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Nível: Pleno


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack apaixonado(a) por tecnologia e com experiência em React e Next.js, além de conhecimentos em backend, para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal terá habilidades sólidas em desenvolvimento web e estará pronto para enfrentar desafios em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações web escaláveis e de alto desempenho utilizando React e Next.js no frontend.

- Implementar soluções eficientes no backend utilizando (especificar tecnologias de backend, como Node.js, Express, etc.).

- Colaborar com designers e outros desenvolvedores para criar interfaces de usuário atraentes e funcionais.

- Participar de reuniões de planejamento e revisão de código, contribuindo com ideias e soluções criativas.

- Escrever código limpo, reutilizável e documentado em ambas as camadas do sistema.

- Realizar testes para garantir a qualidade do software.

- Manter-se atualizado sobre as novas tendências e tecnologias do mercado.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com React e Next.js no frontend.

- Conhecimento em linguagens de programação backend, como JavaScript (Node.js), Python, Ruby, etc.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados (SQL e/ou NoSQL).

- Conhecimento em JavaScript, HTML e CSS.

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git.

- Habilidade em resolver problemas e trabalhar de forma independente.

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

title: Analista Funcional SalesForce Sênior
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas.

♿


Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece.

Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade


Sobre a oportunidade:

Atuar no time de CRM Systems (Salesforce) desenvolvendo e evoluindo soluções com foco em Service Cloud, garantindo qualidade técnica, aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento e integração com demais sistemas corporativos.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções em Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Implementação e evolução de Apex
  • Implementação e utilização de Platform Events
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de Flows
  • Configuração e evolução de Omnichannel
  • Implementação de Bots
  • Participação nas cerimônias do squad em ambiente ágil (Scrum / Kanban)
  • Versionamento de código utilizando Git / GitHub
  • Integração e deploy utilizando Jenkins
  • Interação com áreas de negócio para entendimento das demandas
  • Contribuição com boas práticas de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código

title: Angular Developer  - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 6+ years of professional experience as Angular Developer;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Angular;
  • Experience with TypeScript;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory);
  • Interest in working from Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Gerente Distrital de Vendas
description:
Job Description


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente Distrital de Vendas.


Você se identifica com ambiente dinâmico, com empresas em momento de startup que proporcionam alto potencial de crescimento profissional?


Estamos em busca de Pessoas Campeãs que queiram se desafiar e estar conosco para alçar voos cada vez mais altos!


Responsabilidades:


  • Liderando um time direto, fica responsável pelos Canais de Distribuição, Redes e Território (Canal Independente)
  • Responsável pelo desenvolvimento das capacidades funcionais e competências do time, através das ferramentas disponibilizadas pela cia;
  • Ser corresponsável na definição de um GTM de vendas otimizada, eficiente e rentável para o cumprimento dos objetivos traçados; Identificando lacunas nas áreas de cobertura dentro do território e avaliando oportunidades de investimento em cobertura. (Gestão de White Space);
  • Gerir Sell In, Sell Out, Estoques e política comercial dos Canais de Redes e Distribuição;
  • Implementar, acompanhar e apoiar os planos (JBPs) dos parceiros de Distribuição e Redes;
  • Redes: Implementar, acompanhar e Liderar as estratégias dos trimestres para a ativação do portfólio de marcas em coordenando a execução das equipes de Venda incluindo política de varejo, planos de clientes por UF, DOH da UF;
  • Assegurar a execução do plano de ativação em linha com o orçamento, atuando rapidamente no caso de ações corretivas e influenciando todas as áreas envolvidas no alcance dos resultados;
  • Canal Independente (Território): Desenvolver, o canal do varejo independente através de um time de 2 gestores e mais de 20 executivos, buscando atingir a melhor distribuição numérica, faturamento, mix e evolução dos itens prioritários (lançamentos);


Requisitos:


  • Ensino Superior Completo (Cursos de exatas: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm e etc.,);
  • Pós graduação (Diferencial)
  • Experiência Comercial (Indústrias de bens de consumo - indispensável);
  • Experiência em liderança de times comerciais (indispensável);
  • Experiência no Canal indireto Distribuição FMCG (indispensável).


Informações adicionais:


Benefícios:


  • Plano Médico e Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Ticket Refeição;
  • Veículo;
  • Cartão combustível
  • PPR


Buscamos pessoas que querem colocar a mão na massa e fazer acontecer para tornar as empresas do Grupo referência em inovação e no cuidado com as pessoas. Vem ser Grupo NC você também!


SOMOS LEGRAND


Há mais de 40 anos no mercado farmacêutico, o Legrand Pharma está entre os 15 maiores laboratórios do país (unidades). Com um amplo portfólio de produtos (mais de 300 apresentações), atua no segmento de OTCs, tarjados e genéricos, presente em mais de 90% das farmácias brasileiras com forte atuação nas categorias de tosse, gastrointestinal, vitaminas, dermatológicos e saúde feminina.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Backend / Dados (SCALA)
description:
Você tem interesse em uma vaga de Engenheiro(a) de Dados, mas com pegada de backend: a maior parte do trabalho é Scala puro em jobs Flink/Kafka.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolvimento do backend de aplicações web; Implementar e realizar testes unitários no software desenvolvido para garantia da qualidade;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time para análise de requisitos, planejamento de sprints, revisão das sprints, dentre outros;
  • Seguir metodologias indicadas, regras do produto e cliente;
  • Realizar revisões de design, atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Atuar em equipe responsáveis por implementar sistemas big data.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, ou área relacionada;
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente (mandatório, para atender cliente internacional)
  • Experiência comprovada com programação em Scala;
  • Experiência comprovada com Apache Spark;
  • Experiência comprovada em construção e manutenção de sistemas Big Data de grande escala;
  • Experiência prática em projetos de engenharia de dados;
  • Desejável experiência com Kafka e Cassandra (ou ferramentas similares) Desejável experiência com Java;
  • Desejável experiência com Apache Flink.

title: Senior Technical Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Analyst with minimum 7 years of experience with Solaris/AIX/Linux, WebSphere, WebLogic or JBoss and various middleware infrastructure technologies.


Responsibilities:


· Evaluate, design, document, install, test, implement, monitors and maintain complex UNIX/Linux based applications such as GPP, GCP, Total Payments, and infrastructure solutions

· Configuring and support of production, testing and development environments (Solaris/AIX/Linux)

· Troubleshooting, Preparing, updating, and maintaining technical documentation and RFPs

· Capacity planning, DR configuration, and High Availability implementation and testing

· Evaluate, recommend, installs and configure tools for event monitoring, capacity planning, performance monitoring on UNIX/Linux systems providing automated 24/7 production application and system monitoring

· Conduct technical training


Must-Have Skills:


· Relevant academic background

· Good understanding of GPP SP & Total Payments deployment architecture

· Minimum 7 years of technical work experience on UNIX/Linux/Cloud environment. This could include development, technical QA, and application implementation/support

· Systems troubleshooting and resolution of system and application problems

· Excellent customer facing, communication and interpersonal skills

· Experience with the following:

o J2EE Application Servers – WebSphere / WebLogic / JBoss (including performance benchmark analysis)

o Microsoft Azure or Amazon EC2

o Hazelcast

o Oracle DB (including performance benchmark analysis)

o IBM MQ

o UNIX Shell or Perl Scripting and/or Web Application Server scripting

o Elastic Search

o Kafka (a plus)

o Understanding of UNIX high availability and clustering

· 50% overlap with US hours to support offshore client

· Extensive travel might be required


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Técnico Químico / Colorista
description:
Sobre a Empresa



A Sherwin-Williams é uma empresa multinacional líder no setor de revestimentos e proteção, com presença em mais de 120 países e 80 anos de história no Brasil, nosso compromisso é oferecer as melhores soluções em tintas para as mais diversas finalidades, atendendo às necessidades de nossos clientes com qualidade e inovação.



Sobre o Papel



Estamos em busca de um Técnico Químico I cujas principais serão responsável por realizar o desenvolvimento, ajuste e controle de cores em tintas automotivas e industriais, com ênfase em sólidas (monocromáticas), perolizadas e metálicas. Atuará diretamente no laboratório de desenvolvimento, criando formulações, garantindo reprodutibilidade e suportando áreas como P&D, Qualidade e Produção. Local de atuação: Sumaré / São Paulo.



Responsabilidades



  • Desenvolver novas cores sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas conforme demandas de clientes, tendências de mercado ou projetos internos.
  • Ajustar tonalidade, flop, brilho e efeitos especiais utilizando pigmentos metálicos e perolizados.
  • Realizar correções de cor utilizando espectrofotômetro, software colorimétrico e cabine de luz.
  • Executar testes físico-químicos: viscosidade, brilho, aderência, resistência, densidade, entre outros.
  • Avaliar curvas de cor, diferença ΔE, metálicos e flop no espectrofotômetro.
  • Emitir relatórios técnicos e fichas de formulação.
  • Registrar ajustes, histórico de lotes e parâmetros críticos do processo.
  • Suportar o time de produção em ajustes de tonalidade em escala industrial.
  • Colaborar com Engenharia, Qualidade e Vendas em projetos especiais e atendimento ao cliente.



Qualificações


  • Conhecimentos Essenciais
  • Experiência comprovada em tintas sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas (automotivas, industriais ou repintura).
  • Domínio de espectrofotômetro e softwares colorimétricos (ex.: Datacolor, X-Rite).
  • Conhecimento em pigmentação, dispersão e comportamento de flake metálico e mica perolizada.
  • Leitura e interpretação de curvas de cor e parâmetros Lab*.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em laboratório de P&D.
  • Conhecimento em colorimetria avançada e ajustes complexos (high flop, alto brilho, efeitos especiais).


Formação Acadêmica


  • Técnico em Química (obrigatório).
  • Superior em Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas (desejável).
  • CRQ ativo.



Experiência Mínima


2 a 5 anos em laboratório de tintas, preferencialmente com foco em cores especiais (metálicas e perolizadas).

title: Arquiteto Sênior SAP Basis e Infraestrutura
description:
Sobre a Empresa



Você atuará como referência técnica em projetos estratégicos e ambientes de alta complexidade. Será responsável por impulsionar a evolução técnica do time, fortalecer o framework de conhecimento e certificações, além de apoiar iniciativas críticas e o time de Suporte (MS).



Sobre o Papel



Procuramos um(a) profissional com visão de arquitetura, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e forte interesse em tecnologias emergentes como SAP BTP, IA, SAP Activate e integrações com Azure, AWS e GCP.



Responsabilidades



  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas SAP Basis, incluindo migrações (S/4HANA, ECC, PI/PO, etc), upgrades e projetos críticos em ambientes Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Conduzir assessments técnicos e de performance (tunning, banco de dados, arquitetura, etc) e definir recomendações de otimização.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e ponto de escalonamento, oferecendo suporte Nível 3 e 4, inclusive em situações de crise (war rooms) em ambientes complexos.
  • Desenvolver e manter arquitetura SAP, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, alta disponibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas da SAP e dos hyperscalers.
  • Apoiar os times de suporte (Managed Services) e Projetos (Professional Services), incluindo manutenção, melhorias, auditorias, mudanças, atualizações e rotinas operacionais em SAP ECC, S/4 e RISE.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis.
  • Promover inovação e aprendizagem contínua, pesquisando novas tecnologias (IA, BTP, ALM, accelerators Azure/AWS/GCP) e disseminando conhecimento para o time.


Qualificações



  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada.
  • Proficiência avançada em português, e espanhol (intermediário).
  • Experiência Sênior em SAP Basis.


Habilidades Necessárias



  • Certificações: (certificação direta pela SAP): SAP OS/DB Migration, SAP Technology Consultant Expert, SAP HANA 2.0, SAP Certified Application Professional, Certificações SAP Solution Consultant (ex.: BTP, Implementation Consultant, etc.).
  • Liderança técnica e arquitetura SAP: Experiência em gestão de crises, condução de projetos complexos, desenho/arquitetura de soluções e liderança de iniciativas multidisciplinares, incluindo migração e implementação de SAP S/4HANA (Public e Private Cloud) e RISE.
  • Administração e otimização de ambientes SAP: Sólida atuação em upgrades (NetWeaver, Support Packages via SUM), cópias homogêneas e heterogêneas, migração de dados e troubleshooting em ambientes complexos e sob pressão.
  • Base técnica robusta: Conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2), sistemas operacionais (SUSE) e domínio de administração de sistemas SAP.
  • Ferramentas, idiomas e mindset: Experiência com ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Grafana e Dynatrace, além de forte compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e evolução tecnológica.

  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis.
  • Promover inovação e aprendizagem contínua, pesquisando novas tecnologias (IA, BTP, ALM, accelerators Azure/AWS/GCP) e disseminando conhecimento para o time.


Qualificações



  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada.
  • Proficiência avançada em português, e espanhol (intermediário).
  • Experiência Sênior em SAP Basis.


Habilidades Necessárias



  • Certificações: (certificação direta pela SAP): SAP OS/DB Migration, SAP Technology Consultant Expert, SAP HANA 2.0, SAP Certified Application Professional, Certificações SAP Solution Consultant (ex.: BTP, Implementation Consultant, etc.).
  • Liderança técnica e arquitetura SAP: Experiência em gestão de crises, condução de projetos complexos, desenho/arquitetura de soluções e liderança de iniciativas multidisciplinares, incluindo migração e implementação de SAP S/4HANA (Public e Private Cloud) e RISE.
  • Administração e otimização de ambientes SAP: Sólida atuação em upgrades (NetWeaver, Support Packages via SUM), cópias homogêneas e heterogêneas, migração de dados e troubleshooting em ambientes complexos e sob pressão.
  • Base técnica robusta: Conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2), sistemas operacionais (SUSE) e domínio de administração de sistemas SAP.
  • Ferramentas, idiomas e mindset: Experiência com ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Grafana e Dynatrace, além de forte compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e evolução tecnológica.

description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with Gen Z who are interested in participating in market research on Climate and Energy topics. The market research will be conducted in pair with your friend.

  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 60-minute interview conducted via MS Teams
  • Please note that you will be conducting the interview session with as a pair with your friend.


Compensation package - BRL 530 for a 60-minute online Interview per person.

title: Líder Técnico Pleno (Node.JS / React)
description:
O Inatel está recrutando profissionais para atuação na liderança técnica de projetos de software no Inatel Competence Center - PDI SW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Propor soluções que atendam ao negócio e sejam escaláveis, possuem protocolos de comunicação, regras de negócios e integração com equipamentos;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do projeto, operacionais e de apoio à gerência;
  • Definir e documentar arquitetura lógica e executável de sistemas;
  • Realizar a especificação funcional de projetos;
  • Prover suporte ao time de QA;
  • Revisar código desenvolvido conforme boas práticas da tecnologia;
  • Projetar software para integração e entrega contínua;
  • Prover capacitação, orientação e suporte técnico aos desenvolvedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo na área de tecnologia, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Experiências em:

  • Desenvolvimento de soluções NodeJS ou .NET Core,
  • Angular e/ou React,
  • APIs Rest,
  • Arquitetura de soluções em cloud,
  • Arquitetura de microserviços,
  • Banco de dados não relacional/relacional,
  • Cultura DevOps,
  • Uso de ferramentas de design UX/UI,
  • Metodologias de desenvolvimento ágeis.


Domínio em:

  • Modelagem de projetos,
  • Ferramentas de análise de código e de controle de versionamento de código.


Conhecimento em:

  • Design patterns,
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicativo móvel,
  • Testes automatizados.


Seria interessante se você tivesse:


  • Capacidade de organização com múltiplas atividades e requisições simultâneas;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado e disseminação de conhecimento;
  • Inglês intermediário.


Informações adicionais

Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à sexta, das 08h às 12h e das 13h30 às 17h30.


Local de Trabalho: As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: B2B Content Writer
description:
JoomPro is the first and only end-to-end cross-border B2B marketplace. It serves small, medium, and large businesses, handling orders of any size from start to finish. Today, JoomPro operates in Brazil and Mexico, with plans to expand into other markets.


JoomPro is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international tech-centric group of e-commerce companies founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom Group also includes other businesses: Joom, a global cross-border marketplace; JoomPulse, an AI analytics tool for Mercado Livre sellers; and Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany. Joom Group has offices in Latvia, China, Portugal, Germany, and Brazil, with its headquarters in Lisbon, Portugal. We work as one international team, sharing knowledge and collaborating across countries, businesses and products.


We are looking for a proactive Content Writer to support our efforts in content expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Write short-form copy for paid media, email marketing, landing pages
  • Create long-form content: blog posts/articles/ebooks
  • Adapt messaging across channels while maintaining brand tone of voice
  • Apply SEO best practices with guidance


Requirements

  • Strong skills in copywriting and content marketing, with more than 4 years of relevant experience
  • Ability to switch between performance-driven copy and brand / educational long-form content
  • Excellent writing and editing skills
  • Experience with B2B marketing communications and content creation


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or marketplace-related company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*
